subject: Redwood trial — still a priority for Odin Health?
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Ruiz <daniel@odinhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (Redwood for Odin Health)

Hi Daniel — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from our side and the next steps we discussed: 

- Problem you raised: latency spikes during peak batch processing and rising per-token costs for internal summarization pipelines.
- What we proposed: a 2-week trial on a Dedicated pool with KV caching + quantized model variant to validate latency and cost delta on your baseline workload.
- Technical deep-dive: schedule a 60-min session with your infra lead to map network/config and any VPC requirements (suggest Thu Apr 1 or Mon Apr 5).
- Security: we’ll share a short SOC2 summary + proof-of-encryption details.
- Commercial: preliminary cost estimate attached; final pricing after we size the Dedicated footprint.

Attachments: redwood-trial-instructions.pdf (trial access + sandbox steps), security-SOC2-summary.pdf
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example/contacts/ODIN-2027-042

Can you confirm the infra lead for the deep-dive and whether Apr 1 or Apr 5 works? If neither, share a couple of windows next week.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the trial started.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0182

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference for production

Subject: Scheduling the technical deep-dive (Redwood trial)

Hi Ana — nice to meet you (virtually). Per Daniel, we penciled Apr 5 (2:00–3:00 PM PT) for the technical deep-dive. Do you and your infra team have that slot free? If so I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the trial checklist endpoint we'll validate.

If Apr 5 doesn't work, we can also do Apr 7 (morning).

Note: following up here in the thread with two attachments for the initial review: redwood-trial-instructions.pdf and security-SOC2-summary.pdf.

Kim
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check — still a priority?

Hi Daniel / Ana —

I haven't seen a confirmation for the deep-dive or a note from your security reviewer. Wanted to check whether this is still a priority on your side. If the timing has shifted, totally understand — I can archive the trial plan and re-open it once you're ready.

If it helps, here are two quick options:
- Option A: Keep the trial on the calendar — we hold the Dedicated pool and run onboarding Apr 12; no commitment yet.
- Option B: Pause for now and I'll set a 90-day reminder to reconnect.

If I don't hear back by Wednesday EOD PT, should I go ahead and archive the opportunity (so we don't keep sending prompts)?

Best,
Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Ruiz <daniel@odinhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@odinhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick check — still a priority?

Kim — thanks for checking. We've decided to pause new infrastructure experiments until Q3 as we focus on core interoperability work. Please archive the opportunity for now; we may re-open later this year. Appreciate the patience.

Regards,
Daniel
